record_kind: human-confirmed partial design decision, not additional native verification
accepted_recommendation: Retain simulation stop as a bounded, best-effort control in the first version rather than defer it.
supported_contract: Ordinary prompts wait until task completion or a pause requiring input; the separate mid-task cancel-task command is removed.
An explicit simulation-stop control remains available while task work is active.
The stop request uses the same protected serialized connection and cannot bypass already-dispatched work, authorization, target checks or uncertainty.
Report stop intent, queueing, request settlement and separately observed solver termination distinctly. Acceptance of stop does not establish immediate termination.
Retain the agreed complete request allowances, including the 60-second queue-inclusive stop allowance and a separate status allowance for termination evidence.
If stopping is blocked or cannot be verified within the allowed work, report that the solver may still be active and direct the human to CST when intervention is needed.
No emergency-stop or universal timing guarantee is offered. A latched uncertain client admits no further status or stop tools.
evidence: verification.json and attempt/observations.json; the identified disposable project's native messages include Solver run aborted.
evidence_limits: One CST 2025 dipole attempt, not worst-case native timing, long-launch stop responsiveness, normal server entry-point validation or whole-Controller crash recovery. Sampled idle time is not exact termination latency.
